mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over a 3-month period indicates inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 6-month period signals a strengthening economy, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of the instances where HOUST shows sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month period indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over a 3-month period signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points over the same period, it signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% YoY and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp YoY
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over a single month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy coupled with economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over a 6-month period signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where RSAFS shows sustained decline.
